set.about.outro:
I don't expect to maintain this project for the long run, and since I am also busy with my studies, development was rushed. With the help of DeepSeek and GLM, the actual development time was shortened to just three weeks. Even so, the project as a whole is quite complete.
Also, thanks to the friends who kept me company during development. They didn't take part in building it, but I still want to thank them — their companionship was my greatest source of motivation.
